title: TextLink
description: A styled native anchor for inline links, quiet navigation and settings rows; asChild styles a router link without nesting anchors.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Merges the link styling onto its single child element (e.g. a
`<RouterLink>`) instead of rendering an extra `<a>`

props.name: variant
props.description:
default: underlined inline link; subtle: quiet link with a trailing chevron;
action: full-width row link with a bottom rule (settings lists, menus)

slots.name: default
slots.description: Link content (with `asChild`: the single link element)

vars.name: --text-link-color
vars.description: Color of the default variant (falls back to --link-color, then --primary-color)

vars.name: --text-link-text-decoration
vars.description: Text decoration of the default variant (default: underline)

vars.name: --text-link-underline-offset
vars.description: Distance between the text and its underline

vars.name: --text-link-action-min-height
vars.description: Minimum height of the action variant

translationResources.title: TextLink
translationResources.description: A styled native anchor for inline links, quiet navigation and settings rows; asChild styles a router link without nesting anchors.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: default is underlined, subtle adds a chevron as a non-color cue, action is a full-width row.

as-child.title: Router links
as-child.description: asChild merges the styling onto its single child element.

TextLinkProps.asChild: Merges the link styling onto its single child element
TextLinkProps.variant: Visual style: default, subtle or action

cssVars.--text-link-color: Color of the default variant (falls back to --link-color, then --primary-color)
cssVars.--text-link-text-decoration: Text decoration of the default variant (default: underline)
cssVars.--text-link-underline-offset: Distance between the text and its underline
cssVars.--text-link-action-min-height: Minimum height of the action variant

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A native <a> in a shadow root: href, target, rel, hreflang and download are forwarded to it.

variants.title: Variants and routing
variants.description: default is underlined, subtle adds a chevron, action is a settings row. Clicks are intercepted on the host, like a client-side router would.

styling.title: CSS variables
styling.description: Color, weight, underline and its offset are tuned per link with CSS variables.

props.target: Browsing context where the link opens (_blank...).
props.download: Downloads the target instead of navigating (optional file name).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner link.
